methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Fairfax City Business Leaders Tell Spanberger About Rising Costs, AI, Workforce Challenges - Patch
signals.signal_reading: Business leaders in Fairfax discussing AI as a workforce challenge signals that NoVA firms are grappling with deep implementation issues, reinforcing concentrated expertise in the metro core while other regions discuss basic broadband access.

signals.title: RC-RV partners with ed2go to launch innovative, on-demand workforce training programs - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: RC-RV's partnership with ed2go for on-demand workforce training represents platform-delivered, shallow adoption—providing broad access through vendor solutions rather than building deep indigenous AI capability in underserved regions.

signals.title: Virginia’s job losses are accelerating, economic report says. Data center construction may be propping up the economy.
signals.signal_reading: Data center construction propping up Virginia's economy while job losses accelerate reveals infrastructure growth without distributed workforce benefit—physical AI infrastructure concentrating regionally but capability and employment gains not materializing broadly.

signals.title: Learning Law in the AI Age - University of Virginia School of Law
signals.source: University of Virginia School of Law
signals.signal_reading: UVA Law School integrating AI into legal education signals institutional commitment to building deep, indigenous AI fluency in professional training—a potential distributed knowledge vector if replicated across Virginia's higher education system.

signals.title: Norfolk could get AI assist for non-emergency calls - Yahoo
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk piloting AI for non-emergency call handling demonstrates municipal adoption of turnkey AI solutions—shallow platform-delivered capability that distributes access geographically but doesn't build deep local AI development capacity.
